sentences.text: The complaint is that the respondent-State under the judgment sought to be executed required to fill up 14 posts of Designated Officers.

The writ petition was disposed of while taking into consideration the reply filed by the respondent- State, as per which the process for filling up 10 posts was complete and qua remaining four vacancies, the process was to be initiated on creation thereof by the competent authority.
The affidavit in compliance reveals that out of four, only two posts of Designated Officers were created by the Government vide notification dated 4.8.2015 and the same also stand filled up.
There was no positive direction to fill-up four posts, which could have been filled up only on creation thereof by the competent authority.
However, only two posts have been created.

The petitioner, if aggrieved by notification of two more posts, may resort to the remedy available to him, in accordance with law.
.
However, so far as this petition is concerned, the same is dismissed as fully satisfied.
(Dharam Chand Chaudhary) Judge.

(Jyotsna Rewal Dua)
 August 01, 2019 (ps) Judge.
